author: Tpak
body:
As I have stated in numerous discussions, I have been playing alot of Avicus recently. It has been an enjoyable ride so far. But, there is one thing that irritates be so much, that I literally can get my keyboard, rip it from my computer and throw it out the window. (And, yes, that might sound a bit extravagant.) I am of course talkling about hackers. (I am aware that I have been banned for hacking, but I posted why on appeal and fortunately I got unbanned.) Hackers make servers worse, they may not be bad minecraft players, they just make the game unfair. I have encountered numerous hackers whilst no staff are online. This is where I think Avicus should try and recruit new staff, that could or may play early in the morning because that is the easiest time to hack that I have so far seen. This is literally getting out of hand and I demand that we get rid of these hackers and banish them from Avicus. That is all I have to say, I have let all my anger.

Kindest Regards
-Nooby_Billlz

replies.body:
I know the quality over quantity phrase, but it'd be better to aim for moderators in all tomezones; the one this post is revolving around is 10pm in Australia, which is 8am UK I believe. So push for a few early wakeing moderators. 
Now you can put training plans in place, but I thought Peachy already did?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Usually i do that rotation, since it is only 6pm for me. But i do have a life and i sometimes play on other servers, but my Skype is always there for people to message me over and usually i am in Teamspeak in the music bot room or in general chat. And i checked my Skype :P Replying. 

@op
But the thing i want to stress is the fact that we don't need more then 1 mod to handle 20 players, but i understand where you are all coming from. Also, these aren't just random hackers, they are the same people over and over again, ban evading with alt generators. We are working with the developers to find a solution to this issue.
